FULL TEXT:
Ref. CSJMU/P&C/11/5/2022 Date: 21-5-2022
Corrigendum
(Advertisement for the position of Project Assistants)
Please refer to the advertisement (ref. no.: P&C-2/5-2022, dated 13-5-2022) inviting
applications for the temporary positions of Project Assistants in several Research and
Development Projects and Centre of Excellence, funded in Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj
University, Kanpur by Uttar Pradesh Higher Education Department, Govt. of Uttar Pradesh.
The last date for submission of biodata and all relevant documents to e- mail id mentioned
against the project is extended up to 27th May, 2022. The interview will be conducted on 28th
May, 2022 at 11am in the Academic Council Hall at Centre for Academics, CSJM University
Campus.
Dean P&C
CSJM, University, Kanpur
